title: feat(pm): a project seat's patrol is part of seating, recorded on the stub, and its absence is a half-state reading
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiHXKqxUqDPJKZyNHP7BoqTb)_

Fixes #28642
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:项目席坐席时同一动作自建自绑的巡查 routine,座位贴存根记 `Patrol: TRIGGER_ID · CRON` 行,收班同笔删掉;队列空是待命而非停查,「连查几次没变化就停」的习惯不适用;半状态巡查新增两行只读读数:H70(在任项目席的座位贴没有 `Patrol:` 行)、H71(有 🟢 席位的车道上,无人认领且超过 2 小时无动静的 `pm:queue` 卡)。
- **为什么改**:#28560(p1)在 spec 车道席位在任、手上 0 张卡的情况下排队 4.5 小时无人认领——该席从未建巡查,队列清空后停了定时查;规则原本写着,但建巡查不在坐席步骤里,座位贴也看不出缺巡查,也没有读数会报警。
- **风险与回滚**:规则文本只改写既有行,三个文件净行数均为 0,SKILL.md 未动;两行读数只报告、不挡落地、不写标签。首跑实测:H70 报 16 个座位贴(规则刚立,现有存根只有 #19287 写了巡查行),H71 报 3 张卡。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md`〈座位贴协议〉首两行与〈停止条件与待命〉新两行;② `seat-post-protocol.md` 存根行与〈座位 Routine 创建〉末行;③ `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `h70HeldSeatWithoutPatrol` / `h71UnclaimedOnDutyLane`。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`,预期 exit 0,末行电池清单含 `H70/H71 seat patrol 27/26`。
- **需要你做的**:批准本 PR。分诊裁定这是规则变更、以你的批准为裁决;卡上引的原话「为什么会停了定时巡查，skills 是否需要优化」是提问而非明令加巡查行,所以你的批准同时作为 H70/H71 两行新读数的授权(仪器纪律:新增巡查行须有维护者原话)。

## What changes

**Rules text** (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/`, every line rewritten in place; no ceiling moved):

- `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈座位贴协议〉 — the rule's one home: seating creates the self-bound patrol routine, records `Patrol:` on the stub and sends `seat-online` in the same act; the sign-off deletes it in the same act as `seat-offline`. The key pointer moved to the next line.
- `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈停止条件与待命〉 — an empty queue is standby: the patrol runs until sign-off, only the maintainer's order stops it, and the "stop after N quiet checks" habit does not apply. The patrol prompt claims up to the seat's `batch` limit first, then runs the five standby items listed right below it (`pm:blocked` / `pm:on-hold` unlock, in-flight PRs to MERGED, and the rest).
- `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈断粮与跨墙恢复〉 — the old line 「项目席巡查 routine 默认每小时跑各车道待命项…」 is deleted; each part has a home already: hourly is `seat-post-protocol.md` 〈座位 Routine 创建〉, the standby items are the new prompt line, the wall note is the stub's line, no cron chain is SKILL.md 〈唤醒〉.
- `seat-post-protocol.md` — the stub adds a `Patrol:` line; 〈座位 Routine 创建〉 names its spelling `Patrol: TRIGGER_ID · CRON` as where the current value lives (the director seat has none).
- `project-forms.md` 〈席位是读出来的〉 — 「首次坐席自建」 becomes 「坐席即建巡查 routine」 with a pointer to `seat-lifecycle.md`.

**Half-state rows** (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, report-only, zero extra requests — both read listings the sweep already holds):

- **H70** (`state`) — a held `pm:seat` post (🟢 a login; not `🟢 Routine`, not the director seat, not vacant or paused) whose body has no `Patrol:` line. The shared directive reader is used, so `- **Patrol:** …` counts as a line. The value is not judged.
- **H71** (`stall`) — an open, unassigned `pm:queue` card (not `pm:epic`) on a lane where some seat post reads 🟢, quiet for more than `QUEUE_ON_DUTY_UNCLAIMED_HOURS` = 2. The clock is `updated_at` (H10/H30's clock), so the age is a lower bound on time in the queue.
- Self-test battery `H70/H71 seat patrol`, 27 cases, floor 26: firing cases, the live decorated spelling, out-of-scope arms (Routine, director, vacant/paused, assigned, epic, closed, PR rows), the 2 h boundary, an unreadable stamp, the lane alias, and the band and push registry.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` → exit 0, `5158 cases pass`, battery `H70/H71 seat patrol 27/26`.
- Live sweep (read-only), tree `f4027cfe`, 2026-11-01: H70 fired on 16 seat posts (#6026 #6367 #7623 #9831 #12224 #18883 #18917 #19357 #20163 #20966 #24145 #25966 #26620 #26761 #27737 #28677). #19287 was clean because it carries a decorated `Patrol:` line. The triage Routine post and the vacant director post were not judged. H71 fired on 3 cards: #25918 (~28h, `domain:ui`), #25921 (~7h, `domain:ui`), #27890 (~58h, `domain:skills`).

## Acceptance notes

- **The `Notify: seat-online` key is not extended.** The card says the `seat-online` record carries the patrol line. The mailbox key template is parsed by `record-recognisers.mjs`, so adding a field there changes the recogniser grammar, which is outside this claim's file surface and belongs to the mailbox-keys card serial behind this one. The patrol line lives on the stub only.
- **H71 drops "spare concurrency".** No seat post states its cap in machine-readable form, and a cap can span several lane seats of one account. The row says so in its own text: a full seat reads the same as an idle one.
- **`dispatch-runbook.md` is not edited.** Item ④ lives in `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈停止条件与待命〉, next to the standby list it points at.
- **"含前提过时" is gone with the deleted 〈断粮〉 line.** No standby item carried it before either.
- **No director exemption on the seating line itself (no room in the 120-byte budget).** `project-forms.md` (总监席不建), `seat-post-protocol.md` (总监席无) and SKILL.md 〈唤醒〉 each carry the exemption.
- **H70 reuses `seatIsHeld`.** So a 🟢 title whose first token is not a login (`🟢 held …`, `🟢 session_…`) reads as held, as it does for H32.
- **Tier.** The governed register puts `.claude/**` at Tier S. Triage's binding note makes the maintainer's approval the ruling for this rule change, so this PR waits for that approval either way.

## Verification

All 55 ran and exited 0. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: formula/lint not built). It exited 0 after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`. `--ran` reconciliation: `55 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 55 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.

Roster families under the touched directories, run as readings: `check-published-list-mirrors`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:pm-label-desc-cap` and `check:pm-settings-deny-roster` all exited 0. `check:published-readme-exports` is NOT MEASURED: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, 63 packages not built. CI runs it.
